title: NIZONI Whisper Quiet Mini HUMIDIFIER - 2 Misting Modes - Up to 6 Hours Use - USB
categoryName: Home & Garden:Home Improvement:Heating, Cooling & Air:Indoor Air Quality & Fans:Humidifiers
descriptionText:
Introducing the NIZONI Whisper Quiet Mini HUMIDIFIER, perfect for travel, personal use, car, and home. This compact and portable humidifier has a tank capacity of 9.5oz and can provide up to 6 hours of use. It features two misting modes, cool mist, and automatic shut off, making it ideal for use in small rooms and bedrooms. 

The NIZONI humidifier is easy to use and comes with a USB connection for convenient power source. It also has LED lights that add a touch of elegance to your room. With its quiet operation, this humidifier is perfect for those who want a peaceful and comfortable environment. Get your hands on this mini humidifier and enjoy the benefits of improved indoor air quality.
